lines: Thrown into a fire… what 4 words would you say?
They said: Burn him, and support your gods.
As they threw him, Prophet Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, said: حَسْبُنَا اللّٰهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيْلُ. Allah is enough for us, and He is the best Guardian.
And Allah said: O fire, be coolness and safety upon Ibrahim.
When you're afraid today, say his words: حَسْبُنَا اللّٰهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيْلُ.

beats.text: Thrown into a fire… what 4 words would you say?
beats.ur: آگ میں پھینکے جائیں… تو آپ کون سے چار لفظ کہیں گے؟

beats.en: Burn him and support your gods

beats.translation: “Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.”
beats.ur: اللہ ہمارے لیے کافی ہے اور وہی بہترین کارساز ہے

beats.en: O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham

beats.text: When you're afraid today, say his words: حَسْبُنَا اللّٰهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيْلُ
beats.ur: آج جب ڈر لگے… یہی الفاظ کہیں: حَسْبُنَا اللّٰهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيْلُ

beats.text: Full movie of Prophet Ibrahim (AS): link below.
beats.ur: حضرت ابراہیم علیہ السلام کی مکمل فلم دیکھیں، لنک نیچے
